Context: FREOUENTL Y ASKED QUESTIONS

3. Is the benefit of encashment of Earned Leave allowed to permanent Central Government employees deputed to PSUs I ABs and subsequently absorbed permanently?  
Yes, subject to overall limit of 300 days.  
4. What are the pensionary I terminal benefits admissible to a Government servant quitting service on resignation?  
A Government servant quitting service on resignation will not be entitled to any pension, gratuity or terminal benefits.
